    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, ConfusionMatrixDisplay\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "from sklearn.cluster import KMeans\n",
        "\n",
        "# Step 0: Generate Dataset\n",
        "np.random.seed(42)\n",
        "n = 100\n",
        "fl = np.random.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 10], size=n, p=[0.5, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05])\n",
        "lh = np.random.randint(0, 24, size=n)\n",
        "nd = np.random.choice([0, 1], size=n, p=[0.7, 0.3])\n",
        "dl = np.random.exponential(scale=120, size=n).round(1)\n",
        "\n",
        "is_susp = (fl >= 4) | (np.isin(lh, [1, 2, 3, 4]) & (nd == 1)) | (dl > 400)\n",
        "lbl = np.where(is_susp, 'Suspicious', 'Normal')\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame({'failed_logins': fl, 'login_hour': lh, 'new_device': nd, 'download_mb': dl, 'label': lbl})\n",
        "df.loc[5, 'failed_logins'] = np.nan\n",
        "df.loc[14, 'download_mb'] = np.nan\n",
        "df = pd.concat([df, df.iloc[[0, 1]]], ignore_index=True)\n",
        "df.to_csv('simple_login_activity.csv', index=False)\n",
        "print(\"✓ Dataset generated!\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Q1: Clean Data\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv('simple_login_activity.csv')\n",
        "print(\"Missing before:\\n\", df.isna().sum())\n",
        "print(\"Duplicates before:\", df.duplicated().sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()\n",
        "df['failed_logins'] = df['failed_logins'].fillna(df['failed_logins'].median())\n",
        "df['download_mb'] = df['download_mb'].fillna(df['download_mb'].median())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Missing after:\", df.isna().sum().sum())\n",
        "print(\"Duplicates after:\", df.duplicated().sum())\n",
        "print(\"Final rows:\", len(df))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Q2: Train/Test Split\n",
        "feats = ['failed_logins', 'login_hour', 'new_device', 'download_mb']\n",
        "X, y = df[feats], df['label']\n",
        "X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)\n",
        "print(\"Train rows:\", len(X_tr), \"| Test rows:\", len(X_te))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Q3: Decision Tree\n",
        "dt = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=4, random_state=42)\n",
        "dt.fit(X_tr, y_tr)\n",
        "y_pred = dt.predict(X_te)\n",
        "print(\"Accuracy:\", round(accuracy_score(y_te, y_pred)*100, 2), \"%\")\n",
        "\n",
        "ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(y_te, y_pred, labels=['Normal', 'Suspicious'])\n",
        "plt.title('Q3: Decision Tree Confusion Matrix')\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Q4: K-Means Clustering\n",
        "sc = StandardScaler()\n",
        "X_sc = sc.fit_transform(X)\n",
        "km = KMeans(n_clusters=2, random_state=42, n_init=10)\n",
        "df['cluster'] = km.fit_predict(X_sc)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nCluster Means:\\n\", df.groupby('cluster')[feats].mean().round(2))\n",
        "print(\"\\nCluster vs Label:\\n\", pd.crosstab(df['cluster'], df['label']))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Q5: Feature Importance & Predictions\n",
        "imp = pd.DataFrame({'feature': feats, 'importance': dt.feature_importances_}).sort_values('importance', ascending=False)\n",
        "print(\"\\nFeature Importance:\\n\", imp)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))\n",
        "plt.bar(imp['feature'], imp['importance'], color='teal')\n",
        "plt.title('Q5: Feature Importance')\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "nr = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    'failed_logins': [0, 8, 2],\n",
        "    'login_hour': [10, 2, 23],\n",
        "    'new_device': [0, 1, 1],\n",
        "    'download_mb': [45, 180, 900]\n",
        "})\n",
        "nr['prediction'] = dt.predict(nr[feats])\n",
        "print(\"\\nNew Predictions:\\n\", nr)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Q6: Reflection & Export\n",
        "print(\"\\nFalse Positive: Legitimate late-night work on a new device flagged as suspicious.\")\n",
        "print(\"False Negative: Disguised attack with few obvious indicators marked normal.\")\n",
        "df.to_csv('Lab2_Login_ML_Result.csv', index=False)\n",
        "print(\"✓ Saved: Lab2_Login_ML_Result.csv\")"
      ],
